title: Law to protect whistleblowers reporting AI risks
summary: This bill would extend New York City's whistleblower protections to city employees and contractor employees who report conduct related to the use or development of an artificial intelligence model that poses a substantial and specific risk to public health or safety. It would also require city contractors to post notices about these protections at work sites and require the Department of Investigation to report annually on the number of AI-related whistleblower complaints received. The law would take effect 60 days after enactment.
